boundaryProtocol.meaning: For each row bind a deterministic independent generator/ledger achieving these charged values against local limit L. Admit <=L, reject before first excess allocation/read/publication as applicable. Zero successful truncation.
boundaryProtocol.defaults: Default-scale targets are recipes only, not materialized here. Lowered-limit controls do not prove default boundaries.
boundaryProtocol.hardCeilings: Validate H-1/H/H+1 configuration separately; positive safe <=H accepted (subject to other valid options), >H rejected before I/O with RangeError Invalid xan limit: <name>. H=2 depth has no invented depth-3 grammar.
boundaryProtocol.unreachable: If grammar or another approved cap prevents isolated target, record NOT_REACHABLE with exact binding; never count as success. B01-dependent selector cases remain blocked.
boundaryProtocol.errors:
Runtime limit failure status 1; exact xan <subcommand>: <limitName> limit exceeded

boundaryProtocol.cumulative: No reset across files, skipped rows, selector resolution, serialization or diagnostic destinations; retained occupancy refunds only actual release. Parent always wins.
boundaryProtocol.timing: Cancellation at most 4096 work units between checks plus each awaited I/O; cooperative yield at most 65536 units, not a wall/RSS guarantee.
boundaryProtocol.cost: At most one streamed recipe at a time; <=60 seconds per default-scale attempt within authorized batch wall cap. Abort/teardown incomplete attempts, preserve NOT_EXECUTED/INCOMPLETE rather than pass.
